grammar_focus: KS2/26/50 现在进行时 vs 一般现在时(教材 L74 Key structures,方案B换情节包):此刻正在做用现在进行(are filming/are wearing)、经常或事实用一般现在(makes/wants/tells)、状态动词不用进行时(know/seem/believe/recognize/want);辅以 SD get 短语动词(get out / get into / get on with / get off / get over / get through)
scene: 一些名演员今天正在公园里拍电影。他们穿着戏服、化了浓妆,所以没人认出他们。导演想让这一幕显得真实,就让他们走进人群。“这化装太逼真了,”一个演员说,“我觉得没人知道我们是谁。”就在这时,一个公园工人过来,让他们从花坛里出去。“你们不能在这儿拍,”他说,“请离开草坪,到别处继续。”演员们化装得太好,那工人完全没认出他们。他们想解释,但他不信——他以为他们只是穿戏服的粉丝。最后导演打通了公园办公室的电话,把事情解决了。大家都笑了:他们化装得太好,差点被赶出自己的电影!

grammar_card.title: KS2/26/50 现在进行 vs 一般现在 + get 短语
grammar_card.intro: 本课复习“此刻 vs 经常”的两种现在时:①现在进行时——此刻正在发生(am/is/are + doing),如 They are filming a movie right now;②一般现在时——经常做、普遍事实(do/does),如 This director makes a new movie every year;③状态动词不用进行时——know / like / want / seem / believe / recognize 表状态,不说 am knowing,要说 know。另配 SD get 短语动词:get out(离开)、get into(进入)、get on with(继续/相处)、get off(下来)、get over(克服)、get through(打通/完成)。

rows: They are filming a movie in the park right now.
This director makes a new movie every year.
I know that actor.(✗ am knowing)
Get out of the flower beds. / Get off the grass.
Get on with it. / He got through to the office.

specialRules.rule: 美语里“电影”说 movie(英式 film)、“市中心”说 downtown(英式 city centre)、“度假”说 on vacation(英式 on holiday);本课已按美语写。
状态动词(know / like / want / seem / believe / recognize / understand)表示状态,一般不用进行时:说 I know him,不说 I am knowing him。

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Why did the park worker not believe the actors?
options: Their disguises were so good that he thought they were just fans in costume
They were not really actors at all

passage: Some famous actors are filming a movie in the park today. They are wearing costumes and heavy disguises, so no one recognizes them. The director wants the scene to look real, so he tells them to walk among the crowd. "This disguise is too perfect," one actor says. "I don't think anyone knows who we are." Just then, a park worker comes over and asks them to get out of the flower beds. "You can't film here," he says. "Please get off the grass and get on with it somewhere else." The actors are so well disguised that the worker doesn't recognize them at all. They try to explain, but he doesn't believe them — he thinks they are just fans in costume. Finally the director gets through to the park office and sorts everything out. Everyone laughs: their disguises were so good that they almost got thrown out of their own movie!

stage5.stem: "Look! Some famous actors ___ a movie in the park right now."(此刻正在做:现在进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 看!一些名演员此刻正在公园里拍电影。

stage5.stem: "They ___ costumes and heavy disguises at the moment."(此刻正穿着:现在进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们此刻正穿着戏服、化着浓妆。

stage5.stem: "Be quiet — the director ___ to the actors now."(此刻正在说:现在进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 安静——导演正在跟演员讲话。

stage5.stem: "This director ___ a new movie every year."(每年都拍,经常:一般现在时)
stage5.stem_cn: 这位导演每年都拍一部新电影。

stage5.stem: "The director ___ the scene to look real, so he sends them into the crowd."(想要,一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 导演想让这一幕显得真实,就把他们送进人群。

stage5.stem: "Every morning the crew ___ at eight and starts work."(每天早上,经常:一般现在)
stage5.stem_cn: 每天早上,剧组八点到,然后开工。

stage5.stem: "I ___ that actor — he is very famous."(认识=状态,不用进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 我认识那个演员,他很有名。

stage5.stem: "The worker doesn't ___ them, even close up."(认出=状态,不用进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 那工人连近看都认不出他们。

stage5.stem: "She ___ nervous before the scene begins."(显得=状态,不用进行时)
stage5.stem_cn: 这一幕开始前,她显得很紧张。

stage5.stem: "The worker asked them to get ___ of the flower beds."(从…出来、离开)
stage5.stem_cn: 工人让他们从花坛里出去。

stage5.stem: "I've lost my key, so I can't get ___ my trailer."(进入)
stage5.stem_cn: 我把钥匙丢了,进不了自己的拖车。

stage5.stem: "It took the actor a week to get ___ his cold."(从…中恢复、克服)
stage5.stem_cn: 那演员花了一周才从感冒中恢复。

stage5.stem: "He's hard to work with; I can't get ___ him."(与…相处融洽)
stage5.stem_cn: 他很难合作,我跟他处不来。

stage5.stem: "Please get ___ the grass and film somewhere else."(从…下来、离开)
stage5.stem_cn: 请从草坪上下来,到别处去拍。

stage5.stem: "Finally the director ___ to the park office on the phone."(打通、接通)
stage5.stem_cn: 最后导演终于打通了公园办公室的电话。

stage5.stem: "The disguise was so good that no one ___ the actors."(认出用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 化装太好了,没人认出这些演员。

stage5.stem: "They wore heavy makeup and costumes as a ___."(伪装用哪个词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们化浓妆、穿戏服作为伪装。

stage5.stem: "They were ___ well disguised that the worker didn't know them."(如此…以致:程度词)
stage5.stem_cn: 他们化装得如此之好,以致工人都不认识他们。
